# name: # One row per layer. Layers of one name are summed (amix, no auto-normalise), then
# Variant v of a layer takes the v-th file matching file_glob (sorted, wraps around), so a pack
# with 5 impacts gives 5 different hits. Globs are matched case-insensitively against paths inside
# the unzipped packs. Edit the globs to the real file names after unzipping once (--list).
# Drone anchor (ADR-011, #19): soft low hum + thin rising strain. Globs are a first guess — the packs live on
# Santos's Mac and were not inspected; run `bash tools/audio/build_sfx.sh --list | grep -iE 'hum|drone|motor|engine|servo|whir'`
# and narrow them. A layer with no match is skipped. The hum is cut + faded, so the engine loops it with a crossfade.
